items: 【All-Weather Durability】This patio furniture set is crafted from UV-resistant resin wicker and a rust-resistant steel frame. Aoxun outdoor furniture engineered to withstand the elements, resisting fading, cracking, and corrosion. The cushions and pillows are splash-proof, allowing you to quickly return to use after a rainy day

【Comfortable and Relaxing】This patio furniture features 4-inch high-resiliency foam for a soft and comfortable experience. Each seat cushion and backrest are equipped with sturdy flared straps to lock them firmly in place and prevent them from slipping during use. The ergonomic armrests provide support from the elbows to the wrists, allowing you to lie down and read comfortably

【7-Piece wicker patio furniture set】Our outdoor patio furniture set includes 6 cushioned partitioned sofas, a tempered glass top table. You can spend leisure time with family and friends, and it is perfect for use by the pool, patio, backyard, or lawn

【Assembly and Maintenance】Easily assemble your patio furniture set with clear instructions for quick and smooth assembly. The removable cushion covers feature a Smooth Zipper for easy removal and machine washing

【24 Hours Online Customer Service】Backed by industry-leading support, you can feel confident investing in our quality outdoor furniture. Our patio furniture sets will be sent out in multiple boxes, please feel free to contact us if you have any questions about logistics, products and installation
